name: Boolean Constraint Satisfaction Framing
description: Translates the vector space basis and spanning condition into a boolean constraint satisfaction problem. Vertices become boolean variables, and edges become equality constraints ($x_u = x_v$). The requirement to span priority vectors is reframed as forcing all priority variables to hold identical truth values across all valid assignments. This masks the underlying graph connectivity and tree structure as logical deduction, heavily confusing models that rely on standard graph DP templates.
